changelog: Sync from structs-ai v1.25.0: updated content, commands, and mechanics for v0.21.0
summary: Power and capacity in Structs — getting more energy, fixing "I'm offline", substations and allocations, load budgeting, and reactor/generator infusion for your own capacity. Use when capacity is too low, a player or struct won't come online, you're load > capacity (offline), planning power for new builds, or wiring substations. For selling energy on the market, see structs-commerce.
